question: Mrinalini Sarabhai who received 'Padma Shri' in the year 1965 was a recognized __________ dancer.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bharatanatyam**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Mrinalini Sarabhai is famous for Bharatanatyam.
 
• Mrinalini's older sister Lakshmi Sehgal was the commander-in-chief of the Rani of the Jhansi regiment which was an all-women combat regiment of the Indian National Army.
